label: Bible Study
prompt: A merry heart doeth good like a _____: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verse: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
note: Cheerfulness as pharmacy — the KJV prescribes a merry heart.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an _____ love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verse: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
note: 'Lovingkindness' is one word in the KJV — apparently love and kindness refused to be separated.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; _____ be the name of the LORD.
verse: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.
note: Job's response to losing everything: 'blessed be the name of the LORD' — worship through tears.

label: Deep Water
prompt: So teach us to _____ our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verse: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
note: Moses' math lesson: count your days honestly and wisdom starts adding up.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he _____ set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verse: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
note: The KJV spells it 'stedfastly' — no first 'a.' Jesus set his face toward Jerusalem and the cross.
